summary: Multnomah County lookout: 10-foot L-4 tower built 1937, abandoned 1955; the summit is now a clearing reached by a 2.6-mile hike.

facts.design: 10-foot wooden tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1955; the register and firelookout.com say it is gone

access.note: Oregon Hikers describes a 2.6-mile hike to the summit from a roadside pullout on Brower Road, but says the route borders private land and asks hikers to respect private property

visit.trail_note: 2.6 miles with 700 ft of gain up an abandoned lookout road, from a pullout on Brower Road (Oregon Hikers)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com say 1937, but an April 1936 newspaper item quoted on Weebly already refers to a Pepper Mountain lookout. The story gives 1937 and reports the 1936 item.

The register names the Oregon Department of Forestry as administrator without a date. Weebly says the Forest Service retained the site for fire detection after 1943. The story names ODF as the register's administrator, notes that the register gives no date, and reports the Weebly account, so the sources do not agree on who administered the site after 1943.

notes_for_editor: Brief's core record holds up: built 1937, abandoned 1955, ODF, Multnomah County and coordinates match the register. Left open in the story: the 1936 newspaper item predates the 1937 build year, and Weebly's Forest Service retention after 1943 conflicts with the ODF attribution. Access is set to restricted because Oregon Hikers warns the route borders private land; an AllTrails listing labelled 'PRIVATE PROPERTY' appeared only in a search snippet and was not opened. The 1957 Sunday Oregonian field-day item quoted on Weebly was left out of the story as it is not about the lookout's condition or use. The staffing as_of 1936 rests on one newspaper item about a watch assignment. No photos with usable image URLs were found.
